The said information pertained to the draft annual financial results and financial statements of the Company for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2026.The meeting of Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on 30th May, 2026 to consider and approve the annual financial results and financial statements for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2026, in accordance with the applicable law and the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( LODR Regulations ).The aforesaid sharing of UPSI by the JMD constitutes a violation of Code of Conduct for Prevention of Insider Trading and the Company shall take such actions as may be considered appropriate based on the outcome of the inquiry and/or as may be required pursuant to applicable law, regulatory directions or directions of competent authorities.The Company has ensured by sending a notice to the advocate that the UPSI information shared with them by the Joint Managing Director shall not be disclosed or disseminated to any other person except as may be permitted under the SEBI Regulations & Company s Policy.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.
